data.name: L.V. Access Point Distribution Box (JKF3008)
data.model: Model: JKF3008 | Main Components: Schneider Electric & Chint

descriptionBlocks.value:
General Overview
* Asset Tag/ID: JKF3008 (检修分箱 - Access Points Panel)
* Main Power Source: Incoming supply directly fed from L.V. Room (Panel Ref: GHL-26D5)
* Main System Capacity: 100 AMP Rating (Total Box Panel controlled via 2Q1 main circuit)

     Internal Component Breakdown
* Main Busbars: 3-Phase Heavy Duty Copper Busbars (Red, Yellow, Blue) + Neutral Bar mounted with insulation boots on the chassis.
* Main Molded Case Circuit Breakers (MCCBs): 2x Schneider Electric high-capacity industrial breakers with thermal-magnetic trip units for primary isolation.
* Miniature Circuit Breakers (MCBs): 3x Chint/Schneider rail-mounted MCBs tagged as 1Q1, 2Q1, and 3Q1 for localized branch circuit distribution.
* Heavy Duty AC Contactor: 1x Industrial power contactor (wired underneath the MCBs) with secondary auxiliary contacts for automation/remote switching control.
* Terminal Blocks & Grounding: Multi-port ceramic/phenolic terminal strip array at the bottom right for field wiring connections, linked directly to the sub-station grounding grid.

### External Enclosure Features
* Enclosure Type: Wall-mounted IP-rated metallic distribution panel with protective top and bottom ventilated red grilles.
* External Status Indicators: Door-mounted Phase Indication Pilot Lights (1x Green, 1x Red) showing real-time panel live status without opening the door.

instructionBlocks.value:
### Sequential Installation Guide

* **Step 1: Structural Mounting**
  Fix the IP-rated metallic enclosure securely to the designated wall structure using heavy-duty masonry rawlbolts. Ensure leveling is accurate to avoid physical stress on internal switchgear.

* **Step 2: Main Supply Line Pulling**
  Route the main 3-phase incoming armored cables safely from the L.V. Room (GHL-26D5) through the bottom cable gland plate of the panel.

* **Step 3: Busbar & Core Cable Termination**
  Terminate the main Red, Yellow, Blue (R-Y-B) phase lines and the Neutral line directly onto the copper busbar terminals. Tighten all nuts using a calibrated torque wrench to prevent future loose-contact heating.

* **Step 4: Sub-distribution Wiring**
  Connect the output loads to the respective Chint/Schneider 1Q1, 2Q1, and 3Q1 breaker terminals sequentially. Ensure the auxiliary contactor circuit is correctly looped to the control signal wires.

* **Step 5: Earthing Connection**
  Bond the panel's main chassis grounding terminal firmly to the plant's dedicated copper grounding loop to prevent accidental electric shock hazards.

* **Step 6: Pilot Light & Door Interlock Check**
  Wire the external door-mounted indicator lamps (Red/Green) to the incoming side of the main breaker. Test the mechanical door latch and lock system for final closure.

### CRITICAL SAFETY INSTRUCTIONS

* **LOTO Protocol Mandatory:** Always execute complete Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures at the upstream L.V. Room source breaker (GHL-26D5) before opening or working inside this panel.
* **Voltage Verification:** Use a certified digital multimeter to verify zero voltage across all three copper busbars before attempting any component replacement.
* **Cable Management:** Ensure all internal tangled wires at the bottom are neatly bundled and zipped using heat-resistant cable ties to prevent contact with sharp metallic edges.
* **PPE Requirement:** Technicians must wear rated Arc Flash face shields, insulated safety boots, and 1000V-rated dielectric gloves during maintenance or live checking phases.

data.name: Honeywell SmartLine Pressure Transmitter
data.model: Model: SmartLine ST700/ST800 Series | Manufacturer: Honeywell

descriptionBlocks.value:
### General Overview
* **Device Type:** Industrial Smart Differential/Gauge Pressure Transmitter.
* **Primary Application:** Real-time monitoring of high-pressure boiler feed water discharge line loops.
* **Current Operational Display:** High-contrast digital LCD showing a live line pressure of **6.1 MPa** (Megapascals), which equals 61 Bar or approximately 884.7 PSI.

### Core Component Breakdown
* **Transmitter Housing/Enclosure:** Weatherproof, explosion-proof die-cast aluminum epoxy-coated blue/gray housing (IP66/67 rated) to protect internal electronics from extreme dust and moisture.
* **Digital Display Window:** Circular glass cover housing a backlit alphanumeric LCD screen that provides real-time process variable (PV) tracking, unit display, and diagnostic bars.
* **Process Connection (Impulse Inlet):** Bottom-mounted stainless steel female NPT connection linked directly via a rigid steel impulse pipe loop to avoid thermal transfer from the process fluid.
* **Electrical/Signal Entry:** Side-mounted threaded conduit entry equipped with an armored cable gland for heavy-duty 2-wire loop power connection.
* **Local Configuration Buttons:** Internal buttons hidden under the nameplate ring for zero/span calibration and field setup adjustments.

instructionBlocks.value:
### Sequential Installation Guide

* **Step 1: Bracket Mounting & Positioning**
  Fix the transmitter assembly securely to a stable 2-inch pipe mounting bracket or structural wall manifold to shield the internal sensor from heavy pipe vibrations.

* **Step 2: Impulse Line Plumbing**
  Run the small-bore stainless steel or copper impulse line from the main boiler feed pipe to the instrument's bottom adapter. Ensure an inline isolation valve (blue handle) is integrated for maintenance.

* **Step 3: Signal Cable Routing & Termination**
  Thread the shielded twisted-pair signal wire (usually 24V DC loop powered) through the explosion-proof conduit. Terminate the positive (+) and negative (-) leads onto the terminal block inside the rear compartment.

* **Step 4: Mechanical Leak Check & Venting**
  Crack open the process valve slightly to allow fluid into the transmitter sensor cavity. Carefully bleed any trapped air pockets using the integrated vent plug until a steady liquid stream appears, then tighten.

* **Step 5: Loop Power & Calibration Verification**
  Power up the instrument loop. Confirm that the local Honeywell LCD screen boots up properly and aligns perfectly with the telemetry system or DCS readings in the control room.







### CRITICAL SAFETY INSTRUCTIONS

* **High Pressure Risk:** The transmitter is monitoring an active pressure loop of **6.1 MPa**. Never attempt to loosen the device from its process connection, open the conduit, or unscrew the bleed ports while the line is live and under pressure.
* **Isolation (LOTO) Requirement:** Before doing any calibration, replacement, or testing, completely close the primary isolation needle valve and safely vent down the residual internal pressure to **0.0 MPa**.
* **Explosion-Proof Integrity:** Ensure the terminal enclosure cover is screwed on completely tight and the cable gland is securely sealed to maintain its flame-proof and weather-proof field ratings.
* **Thermal Protection:** The process water line can transfer intense heat up the impulse piping. Always wear certified high-temperature safety gloves when interacting with the instrument manifold or venting valves.

data.name: Chemical House Transformer
data.title: Dry-Type Cast Resin Power Transformer
data.model: Siemens CARECO SCB11-500/11

descriptionBlocks.value:
### **Technical Overview**
* **Location:** Transformer Chemical House, Power Plant
* **Type:** Dry-Type (Cast Resin) Transformer
* **Manufacturer:** Siemens
* **Temperature Controller:** TECSYSTEM NT935 Temperature Monitoring Unit
* **Main Protection / Switching:** Vacuum Circuit Breaker / LOP Panel

### **Key Components Observed**
1. **Three-Phase Windings (Coils):** High-quality cast resin encapsulated windings (red cylinders) labeled with phase terminals:
   * **2U**
   * **2V**
   * **2W**
   * **2N** (Neutral Connection)
2. **Temperature Control Unit:** TECSYSTEM NT935 device monitors real-time temperature profiles of the windings to trigger alarm or trip commands in case of overheating.
3. **Busbar & Cabling:** Sturdy copper/aluminum busbar linkages with color-coded insulated high-voltage terminal cables leading to the distribution panel.

instructionBlocks.value:
### **Standard Inspection Procedure**
1. **Visual Health Check:** Check for any dust accumulation, cracking on the cast resin body, or signs of localized overheating at connection joints.
2. **Temperature Controller Readings:** Verify the TECSYSTEM NT935 display regularly. Ensure the temperature remains within safe working limits and no 'Alarm' or 'Trip' indicators are active.
3. **Cable Check:** Inspect the insulation of incoming and outgoing terminal cables (2U, 2V, 2W, 2N) for wear or physical damage.
4. **Enclosure Security:** Keep the enclosure doors securely locked during operation due to high-voltage hazards (indicated by the Dangerous / High Voltage warnings).

### 1. SAFETY & HAZARD AWARENESS (Hifazati Hidayat)
* **High Voltage Danger:** Always treat the transformer area as highly dangerous. Do not touch or open the enclosure doors unless the system is fully de-energized, locked out, and tagged out (LOTO).
* **Personal Protective Equipment (PPE):** Safety helmet, electrical-rated safety shoes, insulated gloves, and arc flash protective gear must be worn during any maintenance or inspection tasks.
* **Fire Hazard Prevention:** Ensure no chemical materials, moisture, or flammable substances are stored near the "Transformer Chemical House" enclosure.

### 2. WORKING & STANDARD OPERATING PROCEDURES (SOPs)
* **Routine Inspection:** 
  * Check the TECSYSTEM NT935 temperature controller display daily. Normal operating temperatures must be maintained well below the preset 'Alarm' and 'Trip' thresholds.
  * Verify that all status indicator lights (Working/Green, Maintenance/Yellow, Faulty/Red) on the main switchgear panel are functioning correctly.
* **Dust & Ventilation Maintenance:** Dry-type transformers rely on air cooling. Periodically check that the ventilation grills on the panel doors are clear of dust, debris, or any blockages to ensure proper airflow.
* **Emergency Shutdown:** In case of an active 'Trip' or 'Fault' signal on the temperature controller, immediately notify the control room and verify that the Vacuum Circuit Breaker (VCB) has safely tripped before investigating.

instructionBlocks.value:
Working & Safety Instructions
(A. Safety & Hazards)
(Insani hifazat sab se pehle hai)
{High Voltage Danger}: Is low-voltage panel (380V) par kaam karte waqt hamesha =={insulation gloves}== aur =={safety shoes}== pehnein. Khule conductors ko hargiz na chuwein.
{Arc Flash Risk}: Breaker ko operate (Close/Open) karte waqt panel door band hona chahiye. Arc flash ka khatra hamesha rehta hai.
{Lock Out Tag Out (LOTO)}: Kisi bhi kism ki maintenance se pehle panel ko =={fully de-energize}== karein aur =={LOTO}== procedure apply karein.
(B. Working Procedures)
(Panel ko operate karne ka tariqa)
{Breaker Operation}: Siemens 3WT8 ACB ko operate karne ke liye =={manual closing/tripping buttons}== (Red/Green buttons) ka use karein. Breaker status (Open/Close) indicator lights se verify karein.
{Monitoring}: YH396E-E digital meter par =={voltage}== (Ua, Ub, Uc) aur =={frequency}== regularly check karein ke wo parameters ke mutabiq hain (around 220V Line-to-Neutral).
{Temperature Control}: KD-NLX dew controller par temperature check karein aur ensure karein ke =={internal heating}== function condensation (nami) ko rokhne ke liye working condition mein ho.

descriptionBlocks.value:
(A. Panel Ratings & Specifications)
* =={System Label}==: 20 tons of salt water system
* =={Cabinet Type}==: Low-voltage AC Power Distributing Cabinet (MNS)
* =={Nominal Voltage}==: 380 V
* =={Nominal Frequency}==: 50 Hz
* =={Nominal Current}==: 1000 A
* =={Protection Grade}==: IP40
* =={Standard Code}==: GB7251
* =={Manufacturer}==: Suzhou Industrials Park Heshun Electric Co., Ltd.

(B. Component Interface)
* =={Rotary Switch}==: Multi-position control switch with TRIP, ON, OFF, and RESET OFF positions.
* =={Digital Multimeter}==: YH372L-E digital display measuring live phase voltages (approx. 222V - 223V) and system frequency (50.08 Hz).
* =={Status Indicators}==: Dedicated lights for POWER SIGNAL and TRIPPING SIGNAL.
* =={Position Mechanical Indicator}==: Small viewport window displaying breaker physical state via color/text (Disconnect, Connect, Test).

instructionBlocks.value:
(A. Pre-Operation Check)
* Verify the current status on the =={YH372L-E digital meter}== before performing any mechanical movement.
* Ensure the rotary handle is turned to the =={OFF / TRIP}== position before attempting to change the module position.

(B. Draw-Out / Rack-Out Procedure)
* 1. Press or release the mechanical lock latch located at the bottom slot labeled =={OUT / IN}==.
* 2. Use the designated racking handle in the =={RACK OUT}== slot and rotate counter-clockwise (Left arrow direction as shown on the instruction sticker).
* 3. Monitor the mechanical indicator window until it shifts from RED (Connect) to GREEN (Test), and finally to BLACK =={DISCONNECT}== position.
* 4. Once fully disconnected, safely pull the drawer module out using the main black handle.

(C. Rack-In Procedure)
* 1. Align the drawer module correctly with the guide rails and push it firmly inside the compartment.
* 2. Insert the racking handle into the operating port and rotate clockwise toward the =={RACK IN}== position (Right arrow direction).
* 3. Continue rotating until the internal mechanism locks and the mechanical indicator explicitly confirms the =={CONNECT}== state.
* 4. Turn the front rotary switch back to the =={ON}== position to energize the sub-feeder circuit.

instructionBlocks.value:
1. Isolate target load lines by completely rotating the front selector handle directly into TRIP/OFF state.
2. Extract the sliding module partition unit to verify spring retention force on output clip stabs.

4. Clean display fascia panels thoroughly with clean non-metallic anti-static brushes.

* > ⚠️ **==CAUTION: MECHANICAL INTELOCK FORCE==** — Do not attempt pulling the framework drawer assembly with excessive power forces if the interlock mechanism stays locked.
* > 🛑 **Never touch main primary jaw copper contacts** without ensuring verified earth line grounding connections.

instructionBlocks.value:
(A. Pre-Operation Check)

* Ensure that the local Rotary Switch is turned to the "OFF / TRIP" position to avoid arcing during mechanical movement.

(B. Draw-Out / Rack-Out Procedure)

* 1. Slide the module back onto its compartment alignment rails until firmly seated.
* 2. Rotate the racking handle clockwise to rack-in.
* 3. Ensure the mechanical window shifts back to "CONNECT" state (marked in RED).
* 4. Switch the rotary selector to the "ON" position to restore power to the Neutralization Pump.

instructionBlocks.value:
(A. Pre-Operation Verification)
* Check the current state of the L.P D.M Pump via the YH372L-E digital interface before starting any physical draw-out operations.
* Always switch the front local Rotary Selector to the "OFF / TRIP" position to secure the circuit before performing mechanical racking.

(B. Drawer Draw-Out (Rack-Out) Procedure)
* 1. Locate the mechanical slider latch labeled < OUT / IN > at the bottom right of the switch panel.
* 2. Insert the racking tool into the operating port and rotate counter-clockwise (racking out).
* 3. Closely monitor the mechanical position indicator viewport as it shifts states from RED (Connect) to GREEN (Test) and then to BLACK (Disconnect).
* 4. Once fully isolated, grip the bottom black pull-handles and slide the drawer module completely out of the cabinet frame.

(C. Drawer Insert (Rack-In) Procedure)
* 1. Align the L.P D.M Pump drawer unit perfectly onto its compartment guide rails and slide it smoothly inward.
* 2. Put the racking handle into the port and rotate clockwise (racking in).
* 3. Confirm that the mechanical indicator window fully registers the "CONNECT" status (denoted by a solid RED indicator).
* 4. Rotate the front selector switch back to the "ON" position to restore local and remote command control to the pump.
